Callout.Name: Hotel Fire - Evacuation
Callout.Message: Fire in a hotel, guests being woken.
Callout.Advisory: Staff counting guests at the assembly point.

Script.Line: We are counting heads and two rooms are not answering.
The fire is on the second floor and the doors are heavy.
I have got the master key. Tell me where to start.

Lines.Approach: Staff are knocking doors and counting heads at the front. Two rooms are not answering.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
